source: SRS/Abdallah Namoura SRS 2.0.pdf, section 5.1.3 User Requirements
statusRule: pass only when every listed automated test passes; absent or failing tests are fail

requirements.requirement: Register with unique email and compliant password
tests: backend/test/passwordPolicy.test.js: password policy accepts a password meeting every requirement
frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: registration failure notification includes the backend reason within 2 seconds

requirements.requirement: Log in with registered email and password
tests: frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: login success notification appears within 2 seconds

requirements.requirement: Recover password through a secure process that verifies account ownership before setting a new password
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: password recovery verifies account ownership before accepting a new password
frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: password reset success notification appears within 2 seconds

requirements.requirement: Connect a wallet when provider is available
tests: frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: wallet connection success notification appears within 2 seconds
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: a linked wallet can be disconnected without removing account access

requirements.requirement: Receive notifications for no connected wallet, unavailable provider, rejected request, and failed connection
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: wallet UI reports no connection and a missing provider
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: wallet UI reports a rejected connection request
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: wallet UI reports a failed connection when no account is returned
frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: wallet connection failure notification includes the backend reason within 2 seconds

requirements.requirement: Verify wallet ownership with signed message before linking
tests: frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: wallet connection success notification appears within 2 seconds
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: a linked wallet can be disconnected without removing account access

requirements.requirement: Send native cryptocurrency to a valid wallet address or registered user with a valid linked wallet
tests: backend/test/transactionRoutes.test.js: authenticated send returns 202 using injected verification and RPC dependencies within two seconds
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: registered-user recipient and amount appear in summary before cancellation

requirements.requirement: Review both recipient and transfer amount on the summary before submission
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: registered-user recipient and amount appear in summary before cancellation

requirements.requirement: Confirm or cancel from the summary before blockchain submission
tests: frontend/e2e/performance.spec.js: validated transaction submits within 2 seconds after confirmation excluding blockchain confirmation
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: registered-user recipient and amount appear in summary before cancellation

requirements.requirement: View pending, successful, and failed transaction status
tests: frontend/e2e/performance.spec.js: validated transaction submits within 2 seconds after confirmation excluding blockchain confirmation
frontend/e2e/performance.spec.js: terminal blockchain hash reaches the UI within 2 seconds of the backend result
frontend/e2e/performance.spec.js: terminal transaction failure reason is shown in the UI within 2 seconds

requirements.requirement: View the configured native BNB wallet balance on the dashboard
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: dashboard shows native BNB balance and configurable fiat value

requirements.requirement: View simulated fiat equivalent using configured exchange rate
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: dashboard shows native BNB balance and configurable fiat value
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: complete transaction history displays every returned record

requirements.requirement: Filter history by date, sent/received, and status
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: transaction history applies date, direction, and status filters
backend/test/transactionRoutes.test.js: my transactions query accepts every supported status and view
